title: Garlic Pesto Uzu Pasta
description: A simple yet flavorful pasta dish featuring uzu, garlic, and pesto sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add pesto sauce and stir to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add cherry tomatoes (or uzu) and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Combine cooked pasta and tomato mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
